require 'sinatra'
require 'bcrypt'
require 'json'
require 'securerandom'
require 'redis'

class PaymentGateway < Sinatra::Base
  ROLES = { 'admin' => 3, 'merchant' => 2, 'user' => 1 }.freeze
  MAX_ATTEMPTS = 5
  LOCKOUT_DURATION = 900 # 15 minutes
  RATE_WINDOW = 300 # 5 minutes

  configure do
    set :redis, Redis.new(url: ENV['REDIS_URL'] || 'redis://localhost:6379')
    set :session_secret, ENV['SESSION_SECRET'] || SecureRandom.hex(32)
    enable :sessions
  end

  helpers do
    def redis
      settings.redis
    end

    def current_user
      return nil unless session[:user_id]
      user_data = redis.hgetall("user:#{session[:user_id]}")
      user_data.empty? ? nil : user_data
    end

    def require_role(minimum_role)
      user = current_user
      halt 401, { error: 'Unauthorized' }.to_json unless user
      user_level = ROLES[user['role']] || 0
      required_level = ROLES[minimum_role] || 99
      halt 403, { error: 'Forbidden' }.to_json unless user_level >= required_level
    end

    def check_rate_limit(identifier)
      key = "rate_limit:#{identifier}"
      current = redis.get(key).to_i
      current < MAX_ATTEMPTS
    end

    def increment_attempts(identifier)
      key = "rate_limit:#{identifier}"
      redis.multi do |tx|
        tx.incr(key)
        tx.expire(key, RATE_WINDOW)
      end
    end

    def reset_attempts(identifier)
      redis.del("rate_limit:#{identifier}")
    end

    def account_locked?(username)
      lockout_key = "lockout:#{username}"
      redis.exists?(lockout_key)
    end

    def lock_account(username)
      lockout_key = "lockout:#{username}"
      redis.setex(lockout_key, LOCKOUT_DURATION, '1')
    end

    def authenticate_user(username, password)
      user_id = redis.get("username:#{username}")
      return nil unless user_id
      user_data = redis.hgetall("user:#{user_id}")
      return nil if user_data.empty?
      stored_hash = user_data['password_hash']
      return nil unless stored_hash
      if BCrypt::Password.new(stored_hash) == password
        user_data.merge('id' => user_id)
      else
        nil
      end
    end

    def generate_payment_token(amount, merchant_id)
      token = SecureRandom.urlsafe_base64(32)
      redis.setex("payment:#{token}", 3600, {
        amount: amount,
        merchant_id: merchant_id,
        status: 'pending'
      }.to_json)
      token
    end

    # Prevent session fixation by discarding any pre-existing session
    # state at the point of privilege change (successful authentication).
    def rotate_session!
      session.clear
    end
  end

  post '/api/v1/auth/login' do
    content_type :json
    body = JSON.parse(request.body.read) rescue halt(400, { error: 'Invalid JSON' }.to_json)
    username = body['username'].to_s.strip.downcase
    password = body['password'].to_s

    halt 422, { error: 'Missing credentials' }.to_json if username.empty? || password.empty?

    if account_locked?(username)
      halt 423, { error: 'Account locked', retry_after: LOCKOUT_DURATION }.to_json
    end

    client_ip = request.ip
    composite_key = "#{client_ip}:#{username}"

    unless check_rate_limit(composite_key)
      halt 429, { error: 'Too many requests' }.to_json
    end

    user = authenticate_user(username, password)

    if user
      reset_attempts(composite_key)
      rotate_session!
      session[:user_id] = user['id']
      session[:role] = user['role']
      session[:authenticated_at] = Time.now.to_i
      { success: true, role: user['role'] }.to_json
    else
      increment_attempts(composite_key)
      attempts_key = "failed:#{username}"
      total_failures = redis.incr(attempts_key)
      redis.expire(attempts_key, RATE_WINDOW)
      if total_failures >= MAX_ATTEMPTS
        lock_account(username)
      end
      halt 401, { error: 'Invalid credentials' }.to_json
    end
  end

  post '/api/v1/auth/service_login' do
    content_type :json
    body = JSON.parse(request.body.read) rescue halt(400, { error: 'Invalid JSON' }.to_json)
    service_token = body['service_token'].to_s
    target_username = body['username'].to_s.strip.downcase

    expected_token = redis.get('config:service_auth_token')
    halt 401, { error: 'Invalid service token' }.to_json unless expected_token
    halt 401, { error: 'Invalid service token' }.to_json unless secure_compare(service_token, expected_token)

    # Service login is restricted - cannot assume admin role
    user_id = redis.get("username:#{target_username}")
    halt 404, { error: 'User not found' }.to_json unless user_id
    user_data = redis.hgetall("user:#{user_id}")
    effective_role = user_data['role']
    halt 403, { error: 'Cannot service-login as admin' }.to_json if effective_role == 'admin'

    rotate_session!
    session[:user_id] = user_id
    session[:role] = effective_role
    session[:authenticated_at] = Time.now.to_i
    session[:via_service] = true
    { success: true, role: effective_role }.to_json
  end

  post '/api/v1/payments/process' do
    content_type :json
    require_role('merchant')
    body = JSON.parse(request.body.read) rescue halt(400, { error: 'Invalid JSON' }.to_json)
    amount = body['amount'].to_f
    halt 422, { error: 'Invalid amount' }.to_json unless amount > 0 && amount <= 50000

    token = generate_payment_token(amount, session[:user_id])
    { payment_token: token, status: 'pending' }.to_json
  end

  post '/api/v1/admin/reset_lockout' do
    content_type :json
    require_role('admin')
    body = JSON.parse(request.body.read) rescue halt(400, { error: 'Invalid JSON' }.to_json)
    target = body['username'].to_s.strip.downcase
    redis.del("lockout:#{target}")
    redis.del("failed:#{target}")
    { success: true, message: "Lockout cleared for #{target}" }.to_json
  end

  private

  def secure_compare(a, b)
    return false if a.nil? || b.nil?
    return false if a.bytesize != b.bytesize
    l = a.unpack('C*')
    r = b.unpack('C*')
    result = 0
    l.zip(r) { |x, y| result |= x ^ y }
    result == 0
  end
end
